title: Hook Bank | DTC & Ecommerce
description: 200 ready-to-use ad hooks for DTC and ecommerce brands, 100 for Meta and 100 for TikTok. Every hook is tagged by funnel stage, hook type, and product category so it can be filtered.

funnelStage.label: TOF
funnelStage.description: Top of funnel. Cold audience, stop the scroll, no product knowledge assumed.

funnelStage.label: MOF
funnelStage.description: Middle of funnel. Problem aware, weighing options, needs a reason to believe.

funnelStage.label: BOF
funnelStage.description: Bottom of funnel. Warm, close to buying, needs the objection handled.

placeholderKey.meaning: The category it sits in (trainers, protein powder, air fryer)
The customer problem the product solves
The differentiating ingredient, material, spec or mechanism
The credible authority for that category
